articles.title: Stablecoin-powered neobank Fasset raises $51 million to expand across emerging markets
articles.snippet: The Shariah-compliant digital bank is part of a growing wave of fintech startups building banking and payments services on top of blockchain and stablecoin rails.

articles.title: BlackRock, Janus Henderson tokenized funds get instant redemptions with new $1 billion facility
articles.snippet: A new credit facility by Grove aims to allow instant redemptions into stablecoins from BlackRock's BUIDL and Janus Henderson's money market funds, reducing settlement time from days to instantaneous.
